vulnerability_title: The L2 Processor doesn’t correctly redirect the tokens of failed deposits

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: In redeem, a queued STAKE request that was not queued for low balance, for example because the contract was paused or the stake call failed, is sent to the Collector with topUpBalance(amount, operation). The operation is still STAKE, not UNSTAKE_RETIRED, so the tokens are not routed back to L1.
patterns_found: failed stake funds sent to the collector under the STAKE operation
issues: How the Collector treats a STAKE operation is in Collector.sol, not in this file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: wrong operation type when returning failed stake funds
